routes.title: Demo Tools - free online text utilities
routes.description: Demo Tools is a small set of free online text utilities that run in your browser: count words, convert case and tidy up copied text quickly.
routes.body:
Demo Tools is a small collection of text utilities that run entirely in your browser. Nothing you type is uploaded.

Pick a tool below, paste your text and get the result instantly. There is no sign-up and no limit on how much text you can process.

- Count words, characters and sentences
- Convert text between upper, lower and title case

items.name: Case converter
items.description: Change the case of any text

routes.title: Word Counter - count words and characters online
routes.description: Count the words, characters, sentences and paragraphs in any text. Paste your writing, see live totals and reading time. Free and private.
routes.body:
Paste or type your text and the totals update as you go. The counter works for essays, tweets, product descriptions and anything else with a length limit.

## How it works

Words are runs of characters separated by whitespace. Characters are counted with and without spaces, and reading time assumes about 200 words per minute.

## Why use it

- Stay inside a character limit before you post
- Check an essay against a word target
- Nothing is uploaded: counting happens in your browser

faq.a: Yes. It is free, needs no account and has no length limit.
No. The text never leaves your browser, so it stays **private**.

routes.title: Case Converter - upper, lower and title case online
routes.description: Convert text to UPPER CASE, lower case, Title Case or Sentence case in one click. Paste your text, copy the result. Free, fast and private.
routes.body:
Fix text that was typed with caps lock on, turn a headline into Title Case or lower-case a whole list in one step.

## Supported cases

- UPPER CASE and lower case
- Title Case and Sentence case

Everything runs locally in your browser, so you can safely paste private notes.

faq.a: Yes. Only the letters change; spacing and line breaks stay as they were.
